fund_name: Grant Pool to Promote Energy Export Efforts
summary: This grant pool supports projects that promote green energy-related export initiatives and strengthen Danish companies' international energy export activities. It prioritizes projects that increase knowledge of new markets for green energy technology exports and involve clear partner engagement.
eligible_applicants: Project partners with clearly defined roles
activity_types: Promotion of green energy export projects
Market knowledge development for energy technology export
Collaborative projects with defined partner roles
reporting_requirements: Projects must meet formal application criteria
Projects are scored and ranked, requiring a minimum score of 7 out of 15 to be considered for grants
